company.name: EMIL Group
company.tagline: Cloudnative SaaS insurance technology to manage existing portfolios more efficiently and to quickly launch new products
company.description:
EMIL Insurance Suite: The cloudnative SaaS core system 🔷

EMIL Group GmbH is an independent technology company based in Berlin, Germany. The modular EMIL Insurance Suite helps insurers and MGAs to cost-effectively manage existing portfolios and introduce new insurance products faster. The established cloud-native software enables intelligent innovations along the entire insurance value chain and guarantees complete independence from IT resources thanks to its no-code/low-code approach and high level of configuration options. The SaaS-based EMIL Insurance Suite software platform is used productively by numerous renowned insurers and MGAs to manage their P&C insurance portfolios.
